name: Colossus 2

power_source.value: Mostly gas turbines at xAI's own plant across the state line in Southaven, Mississippi (27 temporary unpermitted turbines; MDEQ permit for 41 permanent turbines), plus grid power via MLGW/TVA.

utility.value: Memphis Light, Gas and Water (MLGW), buying TVA power; TVA board approved a deal in Feb 2026 letting xAI's Memphis-area operations buy up to 300 MW

opposition.what: NAACP federal Clean Air Act lawsuit against xAI and MZX Tech covering the two South Memphis facilities and the Southaven turbine plant that powers Colossus 2.

Proposed 12-month Memphis data center moratorium (sponsor J.B. Smiley Jr., prompted by xAI's fourth data center); committee advanced it Aug 18, 2026; full council vote postponed on Oct 6 to Oct 20, 2026. Would not apply to existing xAI data centers.

news.title: A battle over data centers heats up along the Mississippi-Tennessee state line
New study finds proposed xAI gas plant could worsen regional air pollution
xAI announces fourth data center; turbines to be removed from Southaven site

notes: 5420 Tulane Road, Whitehaven, Memphis (former warehouse plus adjacent parcels, roughly 1 million sq ft; bought by an xAI affiliate for about $80M in early 2025 per secondary reports, not confirmed from property records). SELC (2026-02-16) says Colossus 2 began operations late 2025. The 300 MW figure is TVA's approved supply for xAI's Memphis-area operations overall (both Colossus sites), not a confirmed Colossus 2 load. 'Minihard', xAI's fourth data center announced by Musk on X on July 29, 2026, is on Tulane Road next to Colossus 2 and MACROHARDRR (WMC); a Memphis council member said xAI was building a fourth data center on land it already owns. Trade press reports xAI sought permits for a $659M, 4-story, 312,000 sq ft building on a 79-acre parcel at 5414 Tulane Road next to Colossus 2 (DCD; not opened). Treated here as part of the Colossus 2 campus (one record per campus); split it out if official records show a separate campus or that it sits in Mississippi. Power plant and MACROHARDRR are already recorded under Mississippi (ms-desoto-xai-southaven-power-plant, ms-desoto-xai-macrohardrr).
